# Question capacity — distinct instances and structural forms per skill

<!-- Generated by tools/question-capacity.mjs. Do not edit by hand; run `node tools/question-capacity.mjs`. -->

A skill is one generator; its instances are summed over its cells (difficulties). Two draws are the same instance when their canonical key matches (numbers shown, keyed answer, options). **Distinct instances** is a Chao1 collision estimate per cell (a cell with no repeat in 8000 draws is a lower bound, marked ≥). **Structural forms** is the largest number of distinct number-masked prompt shapes seen in one cell: a proxy for genuinely different forms. Targets: ≥ 10,000 instances and ≥ 5 forms per skill. Synthetic, in-process measurement; no student evidence.
